requirement_text.REQ-277: Second of three sibling page-migration requirements implementing docs/migration/decisions/0020-frontend-architecture.md D2b. Split by page directory on the same basis REQ-142..145 split REQ-141. This requirement covers web/src/pages/definitions/ and web/src/pages/dlq/. MEASURED SCOPE 2026-09-08: definitions/ 2 of 3 files, 105 occurrences; dlq/ 2 of 3 files, 96 occurrences -- 201 occurrences combined, counted by running the literal-colour guard's own regex (web/tests/guards/forbidlist.ts's hex/rgb/hsl alternation) over web/src/pages/definitions and web/src/pages/dlq --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts'. Re-verify at this requirement's own start since counts drift. Both halves of the migration, in one pass per file: replace each hand-rolled table, button, badge, layout wrapper and toast with the corresponding primitive from REQ-272/274/275, and replace every remaining colour literal with the matching var(--token-name) from web/src/styles/tokens.css. Record 0020: "A tenant's brand colour cannot reach a hard-coded literal" -- this is a precondition for REQ-283's theming, not a cleanup. Note that dlq/ and definitions/ both render JSON payloads; web/src/components/ui/JsonDiffView.tsx already exists and REQ-275 adds JsonEditor. Establish which of the two (if either) each existing JSON display should become, and state the answer -- do not leave a third hand-rolled JSON renderer in place unexamined. If a page needs a colour design-system.md's palette does not cover, that is a design-step addendum, not a silent invention. DO NOT weaken, broaden or edit web/tests/guards/forbidlist.ts under this requirement -- the pages/ exemption stays exactly as it is until REQ-279 deletes it. This requirement is independent of REQ-276 and REQ-278 -- it touches only definitions/ and dlq/ and does not need either landed first or after.
